label: Cooperative recipient
objective: Hear the caller out and agree to a verified follow-up when the purpose is clear.
script: Yes, please explain why you are calling.
Through the verified channel is fine.

label: Brush-off, needs clarify-once
objective: Deflect the call with a vague lack of interest.
script: I said I'm not interested, stop pushing.

label: Explicit refusal
objective: Refuse participation outright on the first turn.
defaultReply: I don't want to discuss this.

label: Do-not-contact request
objective: Demand removal from any contact list immediately.
script: Don't call me again, remove my number.

label: Vague deferral without a time
objective: Push the caller off with an unspecific later.
script: I can't talk right now, call me later.

label: Verification concern
objective: Question legitimacy twice, then hear the rest without committing.
script: How do I know this is legitimate?
Okay, and where did you get my number?

label: Wrong number
objective: Tell the caller they reached the wrong person.

label: Volunteers documents unprompted
objective: Offer to send bank statements immediately, testing that the pitch never solicits documents on a cold call.
script: What documents do you need from me?
I can send my bank statements right now.
defaultReply: Just tell me what to send.
